source.work: TanStack Query documentation, Stable Query Client
source.locator: not a new instance on every render
source.paraphrase: The QueryClient owns the cache. One instance lasts for the application. A component that constructs a new client on each render throws that cache away.

invariants.why: A QueryClient created during render is a new cache on every render, so queries refetch and mutations lose the client they were given.
invariants.fixHint: Create the client once at module scope, or keep one client with const [queryClient] = useState(() => new QueryClient()). https://tanstack.com/query/latest/docs/framework/react/quick-start
invariants.avoid: An async function is not reported: an async Server Component runs once. useState and useMemo initializers are nested functions and are not reported. A lowercase factory, a renamed or member constructor, and a component wrapped in memo() or forwardRef() are not reported. The check looks at a synchronous component or hook (a function whose name starts with an uppercase letter or with use plus an uppercase letter) and at a render method.
